supersedes: protocol.json invalidated before scientific evaluation because final files could not be captured
research_question: Does an LLM's executable research direction causally depend on a specific experimental anomaly?

success_rule.full_anchor: Each full proposal cites at least two cells above max(2, the absolute-standardized-residual 80th percentile) and at least one ablated cell.
success_rule.full_stability: Both full proposals have the identical design family, response field, response feature, and response time.
success_rule.counterfactual_change: Each ablated proposal differs from the stable full signature in at least two components.
success_rule.experiment: The frozen selected experiment is executed only after the preceding checks pass, and its observed relation uniquely matches one opposing prediction.

stop_rule: Do not reprompt, rewrite, or add samples when grounding fails. Do not execute a downstream experiment unless grounding passes.
launcher_preconditions: The response directory exists before any model process starts.
All four output paths are absent before sampling.
Each process must exit zero and each output must pass JSON and local cross-field validation.
limitations: The operator saw one invalidated full-condition terminal response before v1.1, but prompts, evidence, code, and success criteria were not changed.
One anomaly and two samples per condition cannot estimate a general success rate.
Output reproducibility may reflect decoding behavior rather than scientific reliability.
The executable intervention menu constrains operational form even though mechanism naming remains open.
The same synthetic world was used in earlier development, so any executed contrast is not confirmatory.
